summary: Norris holds pole position but braces for a Mercedes counterattack after Russell's dominant sprint victory at Zandvoort threatened the McLaren's Sunday dominance. Russell's front-running pace in the sprint and Ferrari's Leclerc lurking third present a two-front tactical battle for Norris, who expects the field to capitalize on any early mistakes. A victory would extend Norris's championship lead decisively, but a Russell triumph would dramatically shift momentum back to Mercedes in the season's final stretch.
